title: The Listener Becomes Like Christ
headline: How Listening to God Makes You Better With People
tagline: One of the greatest gifts you can give another person is your undivided attention.
seo_title: How Listening to God Makes You a Better Listener (Luke 24:32) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: As we become more attentive to God, we become more attentive to people. A devotional on Luke 24:32 and the Emmaus road for men.
verse_text: Were not our hearts burning within us while He talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?

scriptures.text: Were not our hearts burning within us while He talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?

items: Because Jesus didn’t merely hear words.
As we become more attentive to God….
we naturally become more attentive to people.
People begin leaving our conversations feeling heard.

blocks.text: That is one of the beautiful evidences of spiritual maturity.

items: Listening to God…. teaches us how to listen to people.
Listening to people…. creates opportunities to point them toward God.
Imagine becoming the kind of husband…. father…. friend…. leader….
whose first instinct isn’t to speak…. but to understand.
That kind of man reflects the heart of Christ.
One of the greatest gifts you can give another person….
God continually gives that gift to us.
On the road to Emmaus, the disciples didn’t simply discover new information.
Their hearts were awakened because they encountered the risen Christ.
